verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS equity-management platform like Eqvista, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers cap tables, valuations, permissions and migrations, but nothing on analytics or tracking opt-out, cookie controls, or telemetry settings. The permissions item (eqvista-docs-23) controls who can see equity data, which is a different feature and earns no credit.
